::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page is **`self-contained.qmd` with Quarto's own lightbox** (GLightbox)
instead of panzoom, for comparison: the same images, captions, descriptions and
gallery, marked with `.lightbox` and `lightbox:` cell options, rendered with
`embed-resources: true`. It doesn't load the panzoom extension. Keep it in step
with `_self-contained.qmd`.
:::

The page has math of its own: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.

```{r}
#| include: false

wave <- function(k = 1) {
  x <- seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 400)
  col <- hcl.colors(4, "Dark 3")[k]
  plot(
    x,
    sin(k * x),
    type = "n",
    main = paste("Wave", k),
    xlab = "x",
    ylab = "sin(kx)"
  )
  polygon(
    c(x, rev(x)),
    c(sin(k * x), rep(0, length(x))),
    col = adjustcolor(col, 0.35),
    border = NA
  )
  lines(x, sin(k * x), lwd = 2, col = col)
}
```

## Labeled R figure

```{r}
#| lightbox: true
#| label: fig-wave
#| fig-cap: "A wave, $\\sin(2x)$."

wave(2)
```

## Gallery from one cell

```{r}
#| lightbox:
#|   group: waves
#|   description: "Wave $k$ of two."

wave(3)
wave(4)
```
